title: Tai Khamti Phonology and Vocabulary
author: Dr. Alfons Weidert
description: Rigorous phonetic and acoustic investigation of Tai Khamti and Southwestern Tai dialects of Upper Assam and Arunachal Pradesh, establishing comparative pitch contours, tonal splits, aspiration phenomena, and over 1,500 cognate items directly relevant to Tai Khamyang.
